overview: Based on the published agenda, the City of Mosinee Common Council was scheduled to hold a regular meeting to address planning and zoning matters, public works updates, building permits, personnel and finance items, and public safety licensing. The meeting was set to consider an ordinance amendment regarding commercial taxi and medical transport services in residential districts and a conditional use permit for a specific transportation service operation.

agenda.item: Ordinance No. 2026-02 - Amendment to Chapter 42-217 of Land Use Regulations to allow Commercial Taxi/Non-Emergency Medical Transport Service as Conditional Use in R-3 Single-Family Residence District
Conditional Use Permit for commercial taxi/non-emergency medical transportation service at 425 Super Street
U.S. Flag Lowering Protocol for Memorial Observances
City of Mosinee Proposed 2027 Utility Budget
City Municipal Drinking Water - East System - PFAS Update
Department of Public Works Monthly Activity Report
Approval of City General Fund & Utility Fund Bills

discussions.item: Ordinance No. 2026-02 - Land Use Regulation Amendment
discussions.body: The Common Council was scheduled to discuss and take possible action on an ordinance amendment to allow commercial taxi and non-emergency medical transport services as a conditional use within the R-3 Single-Family Residence District. The agenda indicated that the Council may waive the first reading of the ordinance as part of this action.

The Council was set to discuss and consider possible action on a conditional use permit application to allow the operation of a commercial taxi and non-emergency medical transportation service at 425 Super Street in Mosinee.

discussions.item: U.S. Flag Lowering Protocol for Memorial Observances
discussions.body: The Public Works Committee was scheduled to present discussion and possible action items regarding the protocol for lowering the U.S. flag during memorial observances.

discussions.item: City of Mosinee Proposed 2027 Utility Budget
discussions.body: The Council was set to review the proposed 2027 utility budget for the City of Mosinee, with discussion scheduled to inform budget decisions for the upcoming fiscal year.
The Building Committee was scheduled to discuss and take possible action on pending building permit applications submitted to the City.
The Building Committee was set to review and possibly act on the Building Inspector's report detailing inspection activities and compliance matters.
The Building Committee was scheduled to discuss and consider possible action items from the Code Enforcement Report.
The Personnel and Finance Committee was set to discuss and take possible action on staff training requests submitted by City departments.

discussions.item: Approval of City General Fund & Utility Fund Bills
discussions.body: The Personnel and Finance Committee was scheduled to review and approve bills for payment from both the City's General Fund and Utility Fund.
The Personnel and Finance Committee was set to discuss and take possible action on the renewal of the employee health insurance plan for 2027.
The Public Safety Committee was scheduled to discuss and consider possible action on applications for operator licenses.

publicComment: Public comment was indicated on the agenda for persons wishing to address the Mayor and Council on non-agenda items and for those wishing to address the Council on specific agenda items outside of public hearings.
